استجديت (form X)
# اِسْتَجْدَيْتُ (istajdaytu) /is.tad͡ʒ.daj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# اِسْتَجْدَيْتَ (istajdayta) /is.tad͡ʒ.daj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# اِسْتَجْدَيْتِ (istajdayti) /is.tad͡ʒ.daj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# اُسْتُجْدِيتُ (ustujdītu) /us.tud͡ʒ.
